build_anthropic_client: build an Anthropic API client with OAuth or API key authentication and feature betas
build_anthropic_kwargs: build kwargs dict for Anthropic Messages API calls with model, messages, tools, and reasoning config
convert_messages_to_anthropic: convert OpenAI-format messages to Anthropic Messages API format with tool calls and images
convert_tools_to_anthropic: convert OpenAI-format tool definitions to Anthropic input_schema format
normalize_anthropic_response: normalize Anthropic API response into standard message format with content, tool calls, and reasoning
resolve_anthropic_token: resolve Anthropic authentication token from OAuth, env vars, or Claude Code credentials with auto-refresh
read_claude_code_credentials: read Claude Code OAuth credentials from the local .credentials.json file
normalize_model_name: normalize model names by stripping provider prefix and converting dots to hyphens for Anthropic format
test_convert_messages: test message conversion handles system prompts, images, tool calls, orphan stripping, and cache control
test_build_anthropic_kwargs: test kwargs builder with reasoning config, max tokens, model limits, and tool choice for Claude models
